correctness.rationale: All n>=3, R>0: the support h(theta)=R cos(nearest-vertex angular distance), width w=h(theta)+h(theta+pi) and box B=w(theta)w(theta+pi/2) are exactly computed under three exhaustive cases n mod4. The uniform angular folds give B=C(D+cos T), T uniform [-b,b], with no atoms. Direct integration gives CDF and moments; Taylor expansions with uniform-in-x remainder give both variance coefficients and the sharp Kolmogorov constant. Independent vertex-coordinate checker tests 25186 cases, moments, CDF and sharp constants; finite checks are corroboration, not proof.

value.rationale: The exact random-orientation bounding-box area is a natural, complete orientation robustness invariant for every regular polygon. Beyond previously known minima it provides the whole density/CDF, exact moments, a surprising 256:16:1 three-residue fluctuation ratio despite a universal leading mean, and a sharp universal Beta loss approximation. These are usable distributional/risk measurements and a structural phase classification, not arbitrary cases or merely routine accuracy increments.
